description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'UtilityPaymentController' that handles utility payment-related HTTP requests, delegating processing to 'UtilityPaymentService'. It includes endpoints for reading payments with pagination and processing a payment request.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing utility payment endpoints, with mappings for retrieving and processing utility payments.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve paginated utility payment records via the UtilityPaymentService.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process a new utility payment based on the UtilityPaymentRequest body.
